lines.text: It’s project time! Build a guessing game: a random secret is picked from a list, the player guesses until right, and the game reports the number of guesses.
The computer secretly picks a random animal from a list.
The player keeps guessing until they get it right.
Set a variable secret to a random item of the animals list, so it stays the same while the player guesses.
Repeat until answer = secret: ask for a guess and change guesses by 1.
After the loop, say how many guesses it took.
Make it friendlier: if the guess isn’t in the animals list at all, say “That’s not one of my animals!”.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
